text:
Example Studio
Price list, valid from January 2026
All prices are per unit and exclude VAT. Discounts apply from ten units of the same service.
Service | Unit | Price (USD)
Logo design | per project | 450.00
Landing page | per page | 900.00
Product photo | per photo | 35.00
Short video edit | per minute | 120.00
Payment within 14 days. Rush delivery adds 25 percent.
